import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
ad = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')
base = (df.date >= ad - pd.Timedelta(days=7)) & (df.date < ad)
anom = df.date == ad
print("base rows", base.sum(), "anom rows", anom.sum())
print("base days:", sorted(set(df.date[base].dt.strftime('%m/%d/%y'))))
bmean = df[base].groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().mean()
print("baseline daily mean:", bmean, "anom total:", df[anom].unblended_cost.sum())
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    g = df.groupby([col]).apply(lambda s: pd.Series({'base_mean_per_day': s[s.date>=ad-pd.Timedelta(days=7)][s.date<ad].unblended_cost.sum()/7,
        'anom': s[s.date==ad].unblended_cost.sum()}), include_groups=False)
    g['delta']=g.anom-g.base_mean_per_day
    g=g.sort_values('delta')
    print("\n===",col)
    print(g.head(8).to_string())
    print(g.tail(8).to_string())
